referenceSources.description:
A meticulously prepared 1996 Porsche 993 GT2 R, chassis #108, is presented in a studio setting. Finished in silver with bold #80 graphics, the car displays sponsor logos including Magnat, Cable & Wireless, Pirelli, Bilstein, and MOMO. Its wide fenders, large rear wing, and racing wheels underscore its track-oriented design.

Originally delivered to Money Auto Limited in 1996, this GT2 R competed in the BPR Series and the 1997 FIA GT Championship, achieving a 4th in GT2 at Le Mans and class podiums at Spa and Zeltweg under Roock Racing. Restored in 2007 to its 1997 Le Mans livery and fitted with a rebuilt engine in 2014, the car remains in pristine, race-ready condition, eligible for historic endurance events.
